name: DHC-8 Q400
summary: The largest and fastest Dash 8, a 70- to 90-seat regional turboprop with six-blade propellers and a T-tail.

wings: High, straight wing with a slight taper
engines: Two PW150A turboprops with six-blade propellers
Long nacelles extend well behind the wing and house the main gear
fuselage: Long, slender fuselage with a long pointed nose
tail: T-tail with a tall swept fin

tellTales: High-wing turboprop with six-blade props and very long engine nacelles
Very long, slim fuselage with a T-tail
Main gear folds into the engine nacelles

confusedWith.howToTell: The ATR 72 has a shorter, stubbier fuselage with landing gear in fuselage blisters; the Q400 has a much longer fuselage and long nacelles housing the gear.
The earlier Dash 8s are shorter, with smaller propellers; the Q400 is much longer and has six-blade props.
